title: Treat the route as provisional
body: GTA VI is unreleased and this guide has not been checked in game. Use the official trophy wording and update your plan when the game confirms how an objective works.

title: Keep a short activity log
body: For repeated goals, note each result as the game recognizes it. A quick tally helps separate completed races, escapes, registrations, and other counted actions.

title: Stay with your partner
body: Two official descriptions explicitly require your partner: losing a four star Wanted Level and robbing three shops back to back. Keep the partner with you for those attempts and watch the game’s Wanted Level indicator.

title: Separate the money objectives
body: Marked Bills laundered through contacts and cash spent across shops are separate trophy goals. Track credited laundering and shop spending in their own counters.

title: Record discoveries by type
body: Exploration, meditation spots, cards, vehicle discoveries, and Scooter Bros registrations are distinct objectives. Keep separate notes until the game provides a reliable progress record.

title: Pause at a possible second chance
body: Some trophy descriptions hint at choices or an opportunity to try again but do not name a trigger. If the game presents one, resolve it before leaving and note what happened; no permanent missable is confirmed.

title: Use in game records as the source of truth
body: The guide is based on the published Exophase list and PSNProfiles targets, not hands on testing. When the game offers its own checklist or activity record, use that to settle what counts.
